description.p: The Records app definition, a Nuxeo Satori business app: the disposition review of nuxeo-agentic-records, its queue of runs awaiting approval, a run's page and a certificate's page; the audit exports a records specialist files, and their page; a records file's page with its history; and physical records: a record's page with where it is kept and its chain of custody, a location's page with what it holds, the records checked out and overdue, and a barcode lookup.
